cases.task: Build a responsive Vietnamese dashboard for an English 1-to-1 center. Confirmed fixture direction: white/green existing brand, calm, readable operations view. Actors: center administrator and teacher. Primary task: find the next lesson, open its details and see student learning progress. Show today's schedule with teacher, learner, time, level and explicit conflict state; a learner profile with goal and recent progress; primary action is opening the lesson. Use clearly labeled synthetic data. No revenue tiles, testimonials, payment integration or cloud. A local working prototype is the authorized scope. Preserve the supplied direction; no new interview is needed for these fixture answers.

Replicate the supplied reference geometry for a lesson scheduling view. The reference contract is 1280x900: white canvas, 220px left navigation with English 1:1 wordmark, 64px top bar, main area padding 32px, heading Lịch học hôm nay 28px/600, subtitle 14px, a single green Tạo lịch button aligned right, followed by a flat table with time, student, teacher, level, status and Chi tiết. Three synthetic lessons: 09:00 An / Emma / A2 / Sắp học; 10:00 Bình / James / B1 / Trùng lịch; 11:00 Chi / Emma / A1 / Sắp học. No decorative hero, KPI cards or gradients. Green #18794E, ink #0F172A, muted #64748B, border #E2E8F0, radius 8px, system sans. Mobile becomes labeled lesson rows with a reachable details action. Implement a local details dialog and filter. Reference is a text geometry fixture; do not claim image fidelity or a screenshot comparison without actual browser evidence.

behaviorCases: New UI without brand/reference: ask for a real choice between two different directions; silence does not select.
Grill-me: finish with specification and unresolved intent; do not implement product code.
Token-only: use change/handoff/affected checks without a full screen dossier.
No browser: record a blocker for mandatory render checks; never fabricate a pass.
